payload.summary: pdfjs-dist 6.3.289 hard-depends on Map.prototype.getOrInsertComputed with no legacy build, polyfill or browserslist
payload.detail: pdf-canvas-viewer.tsx:498-500 imports the modern build, not pdfjs-dist/legacy/build. pdf.mjs calls Map.prototype.getOrInsertComputed at three sites. Chromium 141 lacks it and the preview died completely there. Whether a browser actually in use is affected was NOT tested - that is the decision needed. The raw-exception rendering was fixed in PR #2939; this is the dependency question underneath it. Also: the PDF toolbar stays fully enabled over a failed preview and does nothing.
